notes.title: OVR Advanced Settings changing to be paid
notes.content:
I Bring a bit of bitter-sweet news but the short version is below.

on or about [b]4/15/24[/b] (april 15th 2024) OVR Advanced Settings will no longer be free it will cost [b]$7.99[/b] (and adjusted regionally).

- If you already use/own OVRAS on Steam, you [b]will not[/b] need to purchase it.
- You have until [b]4/14/24[/b] to add/download it for free, at which point it will be paid.
- It will cost [b]$7.99[/b]

[h2]Why?[/h2]
It has been my pleasure over the last several years to continue to support and develop for OVRAS for over 750,000 users, I want to continue to do so, and in fact continually want to create a better User experience for all users and VR as a whole.

Simply put development is not currently on a sustainable path, and hopefully with this change more time and effort can be put into making up for several shortfalls.

[h2]What's Going to Change?[/h2]
Ultimately this change is designed to help alleviate several issues, including better support through more documentation/tutorials, possibly translations for some other languages, and more time just spent fixing issues that crop up.

[h2]Thank You[/h2]
For the community as a whole and those that have assisted the project through time, contribution, or financially, thank you. Your support is invaluable, and developing OVRAS into what the community wants is an on-going goal.

Again sorry for the Back and forth updating between 5.7.4 and some of the 5.8.* branches.

Hopefully this has fixed most of the lingering issues and Patch notes can be found below:

[h1]5.8.9[/h1]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]

- Fixed Brightness Slider, minimum now 3% by text set and 20% by scroll bar
- Fixed various Re-center / space drag issues
- Fixed psuedo room-setup launch on auto-apply chaperone
- Increased logging around Space Drag
- Changed wording  in offsets tab from "seated recenter" to "recenter"


[h1]Previous (5.8.*)[/h1]

[h2]Features[/h2]

- [b]Battery Tracker overlay control[/b] - ability in utility tab to now disable the overlay for batteries on trackers if you don't want it.
- [b]Desktop Mode Improvements[/b]
  - [b]Steam launch option[/b] on steam there should be an option to launch into desktop mode (this is just the [code single]--desktop-mode[/code] parameter)
  - [b]Always launch as Desktop Mode[/b] in settings tab you will now have a checkbox to always launch as desktop mode, if the screen is blank I would recommend this as an option as it is fully functional now, just will not be in the SteamVR dashboard.
  - [b]Bindings Tab on Desktop[/b] this will now open your default browser to the SteamVR binding interface, it varies slightly from overlay version as you will have to navigate to OVRAS instead of being dropped directly on the screen.
- [b]Added F13-F19[/b] as Keyboard Options via [code single]G3-G9[/code]
- [b]No HMD Toggle[/b] in SteamVR tab added toggle to change steamvr setting to not require an HMD
- [b]Power Button launches SteamVR[/b] in SteamVR tab added toggle to change steamvr setting on whether or not controller button will turn on steamVR

[h2]Fixes[/h2]

- [b]Space Drag Changes[/b] - Removed some checks to fix an issue where users could not drag out of the box. This fix should mainly effect non Lighthouse users.
- [b]initialization Changes[/b] - Will now retry SteamVR initialization if it does not work - this may not work 100% as intended and is something to watch, this may fix some of the automatic crashing users were having.

[h2]Misc[/h2]

- [b]Removed old-style motion[/b] This was mostly a legacy feature, and with testing I don't think this feature is required any longer
- [b]Removed adjust chaperone[/b] This Feature is no longer required due to recent-ish changes to chaperone behavior from Valve
- Made Some Minor Changes to Space Drag code to optimize it slightly
- [b]Removed Simple Recenter[/b] Was not exposed to users, and was just dead code.
- [b]Removed Allow External Chaperone Edits[/b] - Mostly deprecated should not effect other programs

This patch should fix most issues with space drag and your chaperone/guardian system if you still are having issues please say something in the discussion threads or preferably on the discord.


[h1]5.8.6[/h1]
[h2]Feedback[/h2]
- Please if you have particular issues with this build comment in steam Discussion forums or on our discord so I can investigate if needed.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
- [b]Space Drag Changes[/b] - Removed some checks to fix an issue where users could not drag out of the box. This fix should mainly effect non Lighthouse users.
- [b]Recenter Fixed[/b] - Recenter should be working again

- Play area will be centered around origin point if you use space fix features/tab
- Settings don't save in Desktop Mode if you close the window (please either just close SteamVR or shut it down with button in settings for now)
- There may still be some lingering issues with space drag and it jumping when you start to pull in certain configurations

[h1]5.8.3[/h1]
[h2]Features[/h2]
- [b]Battery Tracker overlay control[/b] - ability in utility tab to now disable the overlay for batteries on trackers if you don't want it.
- [b]Desktop Mode Improvements[/b]
  - [b]Steam launch option[/b] on steam there should be an option to launch into desktop mode (this is just the launch parameter)  [code single]--desktop-mode[/code]
  - [b]Always launch as Desktop Mode[/b] in settings tab you will now have a checkbox to always launch as desktop mode, if the screen is blank I would recommend this as an option as it is fully functional now, just will not be in the SteamVR dashboard.
  - [b]Bindings Tab on Desktop[/b] this will now open your default browser to the SteamVR binding interface, it varies slightly from overlay version as you will have to navigate to OVRAS instead of being dropped directly on the screen.
- [b]Added F13-F19[/b] as Keyboard Options via "G3-G9"
- [b]No HMD Toggle[/b] in SteamVR tab added toggle to change steamvr setting to not require an HMD
- [b]Power Button launches SteamVR[/b] in SteamVR tab added toggle to change steamvr setting on whether or not controller button will turn on steamVR

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
- [b]Space Drag Changes[/b] - Removed some checks to fix an issue where users could not drag out of the box. This fix should mainly effect non Lighthouse users.
- [b]initialization Changes[/b] - Will now retry SteamVR initialization if it does not work - this may not work 100% as intended and is something to watch, this may fix some of the automatic crashing users were having.

[h2]Misc[/h2]
- [b]Removed old-style motion[/b] This was mostly a legacy feature, and with testing I don't think this feature is required any longer
- [b]Removed adjust chaperone[/b] This Feature is no longer required due to recent-ish changes to chaperone behavior from Valve
- Made Some Minor Changes to Space Drag code to optimize it slightly
- [b]Removed Simple Recenter[/b] Was not exposed to users, and was just dead code.

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
- [b]Chaperone Profiles[/b] will have to be re-made
- In some set-ups when you start to "drag" you may "jump" a little bit - this should be same as current behavior, and I'm investigating, creating and applying a chaperone profile fixes this issue if it bothers you
- Closing The Desktop Window [b]WILL NOT[/b] save settings, either exit VR or exit ovras through settings->shutdown option
- Auto apply chaperone profile causes room setup to pseudo-launch, it will disappear in ~30 seconds, you can close it, or launch games over it.

[h2]WMR support[/h2]
- Should now be considered deprecated, [b]Everything will continue to work as is[/b], It's more a matter of support if specific features break for WMR only they will not be receiving updates.

notes.title: 5.5.0 Update
notes.content:
[h1]New Features[/h1]

[h2]Device Pairing[/h2]
You Are Now Able To Pair SteamVR Devices With OVRAS.

SteamVR Tab -> Device Pairing Information

In General, with an empty dongle, make your device enter pairing mode (blue-flashing light), and hit pair in app. The Dongle Must not have another device currently attached to it and powered.

[b]Why?[/b] Unlike Steam's Native interface ours allows you to bind to specific dongles. Additionally for users that use additional devices besides the controllers it is a very common for your controllers to  get bound to dongles that are not the Headsets, in this configuration you can have tracking issues, and strongly suggest you bind your controllers to the HMD.

[h2]Space Drag Multiplier[/h2]
Multiplier in Space Drag to allow you to multiply your real world movement i.e. drag 1m translates to 2m in game with a 2x multiplier

[h2]Auto-Apply Chaperone[/h2]
Option in Settings you can now have a chaperone profile auto-apply on launch (great for WMR native chaperone users) At this time you will still have to close out of room-setup so not quite 100% yet.

[h1]Settings Removal[/h1]
The Following Settings Have Been Removed to better support Space Drag Features (i.e. these are all defaulted on now)

[list]
[*]Enable Seated Motion
[*]Enable Un-Cal Motion
[*]OpenXR Fix
[/list]

The Following Setting has been removed because a change to OpenVR/SteamVR Deprecated it

[list]
[*] Adjust Chaperone
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed battery indicator for Tundra Trackers
[*]Fixed an Issue causing some long identifiers to make device pairing information text overlap
[*]Added another digit of precision to fling multiplier to be more in line with the rest of the page
[/list]

notes.title: 5.3.0 Is out.
notes.content:
[h2]Exclusive Input[/h2]
[h3]Summary:[/h3]

This Feature Allows you to toggle between Game input and OVRAS input, allowing only one to be active at a time. This Is effectively similiar to a "function key on a keyboard"

[h3]How to Use:[/h3]
[list]
[*]
Turn Exclusive Input Toggle on in the Settings Tab of OVRAS

[/*]
[*]
Go To Bindings, and bind the "exclusive input Toggle" action in the "System" tab.

[/*]
[*]
Press the binding to Toggle between Game input (always in this mode on startup) and OVRAS input.

[/*]
[/list]
[h3]Devil in the Details:[/h3]
[list]
[*]
Actions from OVRAS in the "System" Tab will ALWAYS work, while in OVRAS mode they will also block input, but while in game mode they will work along with w/e the game's binding is.

[/*]
[*]
Only Keys that have an action will be blocked, If you want to block all Input, you will need empty actions/bindings or an actual binding on every key.

[/*]
[*]
[b]Caution:[/b] I would recommend leaving at least one trigger unbound, as it will block (while in OVRAS mode) trigger from interacting with the dashboard.

[/*]
[*]
Inter-operability with other applications will vary, But co-priority should be possible with other applications that use our same value (0x01000001)

[/*]
[/list]
[h3]New Action:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Exclusive Input Toggle: This toggles between the Game Input and OVRAS input, while the exclusive input is turned on in OVRAS's Settings.[/*]
[/list]
[h2]View Ratcheting:[/h2]
[h3]Summary:[/h3]

This new feature is a new turn method, that multiplies your head movement slightly to steer you away from your closest wall.

[h3]How to Use:[/h3]
[list]
[*]
Enable View Ratcheting in the rotation tab

[/*]
[*]
Adjust value to desired range 0.05 is default, slider goes from 0->0.10 (direct Text input up to 1.0)
[/*]
[/list]

[h2]Keyboard Custom Input Update[/h2]
[list]
[*]
Added \\ via BACKSLASH

[/*]
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]
Fixed an issue with keyboard Parser not holding modifier keys in the right order

[/*]
[*]
Fixed an issue with Brightness option in Video Tab, Direct Text Input will now allow Inputs down to 3% (very dark) slider remains unchanged at 10% minimum

[/*]
[*]
Changed how vestibular motion works, will now only work while +- 70 degrees from forward via hmd, preventing it from activating if you are moving side-to-side or similiar

[/*]
[*]
Adjusted Default values for vestibular motion and Auto-turn smooth speed.

[/*]
[*]
fixes a bug that would spam log if you had a setting that did not have a default value.

[/*]
[/list]

[h3]Misc.[/h3]
- added an overlay for when auto-turn is turned on/off
- added F10-F12 to custom bindings using G# (i.e. G0,G1,G2 for F10,F11,F12)

[h3]Documentation[/h3]
- Fixed some formatting errors

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
- Center Marker Position in Seated Mode Games will now be Below Eye Level.
- Auto-Turn is now based on time not frame-rate for turning.

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[h3]Chaperone Losing position[/h3]
 - SVR 1.13 broke Chaperone Positioning, this will fix that.
 - This is achieved by no longer using "adjust chaperone"
 - If you feel like you still need the "adjust chaperone" option it is now in settings
 
[h3]Changes to Rotation Counter (effects center marker as well)[/h3]
 - We switched to a new algorithm based on whole turn counts + absolute position
 - This should eliminate drift entirely. (well more realistically limit to @ max a few degrees)
 - This means if you are at .5 ccw rotations on reset you will be at .5 cw rotations or 1.2 ccw will be .2 ccw at reset
 - The "zero" point of your turn is now based on how your playspace is situated (should be the forward direction)
 - The "critical point" is at 180 deg from the front
 - The Counter will fail if turning over 180 deg / 7 frames (this is still ~900 deg/s @ 30 fps)
 - The Turn Counter may add faulty turns if you invert hmd and pass through critical section (deemed unlikely but if you see this behavior yell at us.)
 - Obviously we will probably be tweaking this in the future, but curious to see how it's taken.
 
[h3]Misc[/h3]
- Fixes a display issue with settings causing some of the scroll box elements to go over the back button
- Fixes an issue with supersampling not allowing (and forcing) values that have more than 1 Sig digit. (should be 2 now)

[h3]Linux Fixes[/h3]
- For Steam Client disabled integration in appimage.

notes.title: 5.2.0 Is out Now
notes.content:
[h2]Summary[/h2]

You can now bind two key's to press to send to your system, and these keys will mirror your keyboard (i.e. held down when held down on controller)

The New Actions are:

Key Press Misc (in Misc action set)
Key Press System (In System action set)

By Default they are both bound to F9, and are changed and follow the same spec as existing keyboard input.

[h3]I don't know how to use the existing keyboard features[/h3]
A guide will shortly follow the release detailing how to Set-up the keyboard shortcuts.

[h2]But Don't Miss[/h2]

The Alarm has been fixed, and will save across play sessions  It will get more love here in the future, but for now we wanted it in a work-able state asap

[h2]New Experimental Features[/h2]
These are not well tested.... and may not work correctly... because well experiments!~

[list]
[*]Disable Oculus SDK (will need a restart) - should disable games from running on the Oculus SDK and allowing you to run all your (Steam) games in SteamVR mode!
[*]Force Use Native Chaperone - Simply put this allows you to use SteamVR's chaperone, regardless of what system you are using!
[/list]


[h2]Patch Notes:[/h2]

[h3]New Features[/h3]
- Adds 2 New Actions [code single]Key Press Misc[/code] and [code single]Key Press System[/code] these behave like normal key presses, i.e. are suitable for PTT on 3rd party programs like discord. They are Bound to F9 by default
- [experimental] Ability to block Oculus SDK - Added a feature that should Block Oculus SDK from running on any Steam store app.

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
- The Alarm Clock Now Works again, and has been refreshed It will get some future love, but for now When your alarm time hits there will be a large white overlay popping up on your screen for ~ 3 seconds
- Fixes an issue with keyboard actions, not releasing modifier/held keys
- Fixes a synchronization issue w/ Several setting when modified outside of OVRAS (i.e. steam's settings)

[h3]Documentation Updates[/h3]
- Keyboard Input Guide has been updated
- Overall Documentation has been updated

notes.title: 5.1.0 Released
notes.content: [h1]The important Stuff[/h1] This update's primary feature is a re-worked Center marker. It will follow you with space drag, and always stay in the center of your play-space~! It mirrors your chaperone opacity, and Color. It also tracks 1/2/3+ turns in L/R direction and gives a visual indicator. It tracks rotation based on what direction your headset was when you turned it on. This can be reset in the statistics page or in the chaperone->additional chaperone options. The old center marker is now accesible as "legacy center marker" in chaperone->additional chaperone options [h3]New Features[/h3] [list] [*]Added Chaperone Color Controls[/*] [*]Added Chaperone Style Control[/*] [*]Added Chaperone Floor bound Control[/*] [*]Added New Center Marker (tells rotation + moves w/ space adjustments)[/*] [*]Added Reset Orientation button for center marker (this is same counter as in statistics)[/*] [*]Added New Sound Effects.[/*] [*]Brightness Overlay Can now be reduced to 3% via direct text input.[/*] [/list] [h3]Bug Fixes[/h3] [*]Fixed a Bug remembering fade Distance when using disable chaperone[/*] [*]Fixed a logging issue for brightness overlay[/*] [*]Fixed Chaperone Height Slider[/*] [*]Fixed UI text display issue with rotation on chaperone page.[/*] [/list] [h3]Misc[/h3] [list] [*]Updated OVR to 1.11.11[/*] [*]Refactor Chaperone Tab[/*] [*]Re-enabled applying floor bounds chaperone profiles[/*] [*]Moved the Old Center Marker to "additional Chaperone Settings" as legacy center marker[/*] [*]New Center Marker is applied with the "center marker" option in chaperone profiles (both center marks will follow this, old profiles will probably need to be re-made if you want new center marker)[/*] [*]Minor optimizations[/*] [/list] [h3]Known Issues[/h3] The Center Marker Can have difficulties staying on the floor in "seated" games. The rotation counter may lose accuracy in longer play sessions.

notes.title: OVR Advanced Settings Now Live on Steam!
notes.content:
[h2]OVR Advanced Settings 5.0.0 Release[/h2]
[h3][b]This Update is a Breaking change, Please follow instructions below If you have previously installed stand-alone.[/b][/h3]


[h3]This update [b]WILL[/b] reset your current settings[/h3]
[list]
    [*]They [b]CANNOT[/b] be trivially saved and updated
[/list]

[h3]This update [b]WILL[/b] break your Saved Keybinds[/h3]
[list]
    [*]They [b]WILL[/b] have to be remade
[/list]

[h3]This update [b]WILL[/b] change the name from [i]Advanced Settings[/i] to [i]OVR Advanced Settings[/i] In the Steam Keybing issues.[/h3]

[h3]You [b]MUST[/b] un-install the current version before installing the new version.[/h3]
[h3]Automatically[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Simply run the un-installer
    [*]delete install directory
    [*](optional) delete logs and settings [i]%appdata%/AdvancedSettings-Team[/] by default
[/list]
[h3]Semi-manually[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Run [i]AdvancedSettings.exe[/i] with the command [i]--force-remove-manifest[/i]
    [*]delete install directory
    [*](optional) delete logs and settings [i]%appdata%/AdvancedSettings-Team[/i] by default
[/list]
[h3]manually[/h3]
[list]
    [*]go to steam install/config directory ([i]C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\config[/i] by default)
    [*]edit the [i]appconfig.json[/i] to remove the path pointed to Advanced Settings ([i]"C:\\Program Files\\OpenVR-AdvancedSettings\\manifest.vrmanifest"[/i] by default)
    [*]delete install/setting/log file manually
[/list]

[h3]What's New?[/h3]

The Major change in this patch, Is some new options for turning your playspace.

[list]
    [*] Auto Turn
    [list]
        [*]This Feature automatically rotates you to allow you to walk in a single direction forever in games by rotating the world around you as you near walls.
        [list]
            [*][b]important[/b] - This feature does not handle playspaces with wall corners greater than 180 degrees well.
        [/list]
        [*]There are many options available, and it will require some tweaking to get it how you like it.
        [*]Read Patch Notes or documentaiton for more information
    [/list]
    [*] Redirected Walking
    [list]
        [*]This Feature automatically steers you away from the edge of your play area by encouraging you to walk towards the middle of your play area.
        [list]
            [*][b]important[/b]  to give you reasonable additional "length" of your playspace, you will need a very large area or it will be quite a noticeable.
        [/list]
        [*]This feature is independent of Auto-Turn, and can be used to extend your percieved length of your area, i.e. a 2m x 2m playspace may feel more like a 2.5m x 2.5m
        [*]Read Patch Notes or documentaion for more information.
    [/list]
[/list]

[h3]Some Things have moved[/h3]

[list]
    [*]Snap, Smooth, and Space Turn have been moved to the new Rotation Tab
    [*]In Bindings the simulated clicks have been moved to a new tab called [i]system[/i]
    [*]In Bindings the PTT has been moved to a new tab called [i]system[/i]
    [*]The Prox Sensor, and Haptic Actions have been hidden from end-user
    [list]
        [*]They are bound by default, and should not be adjusted.
    [/list]
[/list]

[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
    [*] Rotation Tab feilen UI by ykeara 

    [list]
        [*]Auto-Turn - Automatically rotates you to allow you to walk in a single direction forever in games by rotating the world around you as you near walls.
        [list]
            [*]optionally this feature will also try to direct you so that you will untangle your cord as well.
            [*][b]important[/b] - This feature does not handle playspaces with wall corners greater than 180 degrees well.
        [/list]

        [*]redirected - walking - Automatically steers you away from the edge of your play area by encouraging you to walk towards the middle of your play area.
        [list]
            [*][b]Important[/b] - This requires a VERY large playspace to be imperceptible, its best use is for extending your perceived length of your play area slightly. 
        [/list]

    [/list]

    [*] Friction - when using Space Drag features. A value of 100% will bring the user to a full stop within roughly 1 second. The max value is 999% and min is 0%. Most useful values should be found within the range of 20%~80%. - kung
    [*]Push-To-Mute icon - Added another image to show when using PTM, to reduce confusion. - username223
    [*]Oculus Default Bindings - Added default Bindings for Oculus Touch controllers - ykeara 
[/list]

[h3]New Actions (keybinds)[/h3]

[list]
    [*]Auto-Turn Toggle - Toggles auto-turn feature on/off
    [list]
        [*]In motion tab/action set
    [/list]
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Fixed a crash When Using QT 5.14.0 (both Windows and Linux) - username223
    [*]Fixed the issue releated to keyboard showing up "behind" the overlay - ykeara
    [*]Fixed some error messages caused by badly formed default bindings - ykeara 
[/list]

[h3]Linux[/h3]
[list]
    [*]OpenVR Advanced Settings can now be found on the Arch User Repository for Arch/Manjaro users. - username223
    [*]Added support for getting switching Mic Devices and volumes in Linux.
[/list]

[h3]Misc[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Fixed (un)-Installer to remove all files in the install directory (not settings/Logs) - ykeara 
    [*]Updated to OVR 1.10.30
    [*]Various back-end optimizations/changes
[/list]

[h3]Fixed In Beta[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Fixed Non-Bool Settings not saving - ykeara 
    [*]Fixed some formatting in Rotation Tab - ykeara 
    [*]Fixed some issues in Rotation Tab from some Text Boxes not taking Direct Input - ykeara  reported by open beta testers
    [*]Temporarily Disabled Chaperone Profiles Ability to Set Floor Bounds always on. - ykeara 
    [*]Updated Action Sets -> New Action Set [i]System[/i], and hid the [i]haptic[/i] action set.- ykeara 
    [*]Fixed Default Brightness Settings - ykeara 
    [*]Set Seated Re-Center Button to always show in [i]offsets tab[/i] - ykeara  reported by reddit
    [*]Steam Linux Build - username223
    [*]Steam Linux Manifest Issues - username223 + feilen reported by closed beta testers
[/list]

[h3]Known Issues[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Some features of Chaperone profiles are not actually saved/set properly
    [*]disable Chaperone is not properly initialized at startup
    [*]Some setups will have issues loading chaperone profiles.
    [*]Direct Text Input in Linux is auto-repeating.
    [*]Not all audio features are implemented yet in Linux.
[/list]
